turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste, main Udaan Finserv ki taraf se Kavya bol rahi hoon, ek AI assistant. Kya main Priya ji se baat kar rahi hoon?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan, main Priya bol rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Dhanyavaad Priya ji. Aapki 8,450 rupaye ki EMI 5 November ko due thi aur ab 12 din se pending hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan, is mahine paisa thoda tight hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Main samajh sakti hoon. Aap Udaan app ya UPI link se kabhi bhi payment kar sakti hain. Agar mushkil ho toh aap branch ya helpline se EMI date change ya restructuring ke baare mein baat kar sakti hain.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Ji, overdue EMI par 2 percent per month late payment charge lagta hai, aur lambe time tak payment na hone par credit bureau ko report ho sakta hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Theek hai, main kal tak kar dungi.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Bahut accha. Main aapko payment link SMS kar deti hoon. Dhanyavaad Priya ji.
